Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q. What is the Jaanch STD Profile Extended by Thyrocare?
Ans.
The Jaanch STD Profile Extended by Thyrocare is a comprehensive diagnostic test package that screens for a wide range of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) and infections (STIs), helping in early detection and timely treatment.
Q.
Who should take the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test?
Ans.
This test is recommended for:
Individuals who are sexually active and want regular STD screening.
Those with multiple partners or unprotected sex history.
Anyone experiencing symptoms like genital sores, itching, unusual discharge, or burning sensation while urinating.
Couples planning for pregnancy or marriage.
Q.
What tests are included in the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended package?
Ans.
This package includes tests for the most common bacterial and viral STDs, such as:
HIV 1 & 2
Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)
Hepatitis C Antibody (Anti-HCV)
Syphilis (VDRL/TPHA)
Herpes Simplex Virus 1 & 2 (HSV-1, HSV-2)
Chlamydia IgG & IgM
Gonorrhea Testing
Mycoplasma & Ureaplasma Tests
These tests provide a detailed screening for early detection and management of STDs.
Q.
Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test?
Ans.
No, fasting is not required for this test. You can take the test at any time of the day.
Q.
How can I book the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test online?
Ans.
You can easily book this STD test online through our website. Choose the package, schedule a convenient time, and our discreet home sample collection service will ensure privacy and comfort.
Q.
What is the cost of the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test?
Ans.
The cost varies based on your location and available offers. Visit our website or contact us for the latest pricing and discounts.
Q.
How long does it take to get results for the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test?
Ans.
Test results are typically available within 24-48 hours and can be accessed securely online or via email, ensuring privacy.
Q.
How does the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test help in STD detection?
Ans.
This test detects bacterial and viral STDs, ensuring early diagnosis and timely medical intervention to prevent further complications.
Q.
Can the Thyrocare Jaanch STD Profile Extended test detect all STDs?
Ans.
This test covers major STDs, including HIV, Hepatitis, Syphilis, Herpes, Chlamydia, and Gonorrhea. If additional tests are required, consult a doctor for further recommendations.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the STD Profile Basic?
The STD Profile Basic is a sexual health screening package designed to detect common sexually transmitted infections and diseases.
2. Who should opt for the STD Profile Basic?
This package is recommended for sexually active individuals, those with multiple partners or anyone looking for routine sexual health screening.
3. What does the STD Profile Basic include?
It includes essential screening tests used to detect common sexually transmitted infections and assess sexual health.
4. Why is this package important?
This package helps in early detection of sexually transmitted infections, enabling timely treatment and reducing the risk of complications or transmission.
5. Is fasting required for this package?
Fasting is generally not required, but specific instructions may be provided at the time of booking.
6. How is the sample collected?
Samples are collected through safe and confidential sample collection by trained professionals, ensuring privacy and convenience.
